note: The first input byte controls how many NUL-delimited command-line arguments are consumed before the remaining bytes are written as the temporary FLAC input file.
The PoC supplies -d and --cue=0.1-1.0 as fuzzer-controlled argv entries.
After argv parsing, the remaining bytes are copied verbatim into the file that flac decodes.
The decoder session begins without STREAMINFO having been accepted.
A zero sample_rate sentinel is used to decide whether to compare frame sample rates, conflating an absent STREAMINFO value with an actual zero value.
The callback enters the no-STREAMINFO branch for the crafted stream and compares the frame sample rate against the session value.
The frame header sample_rate participates in the branch that reports the mismatch and aborts decoding; under MSan this is the observable conditional use.
